TreeViewNode.summary: Tree node control, a Control subclass handling child add/remove, expand/collapse, recursive lookup, collapse-button clicks and per-row drawing.

props.classname: Class name string, "treeviewnode", used to identify the control type.
props.padding: Left padding {16,0,0,0}: the width in pixels reserved for the collapse triangle button; set to {0,0,0,0} when the node is root.
props.autosize: Fixed to true: UpdateLayout resizes the node to the total height of its children.
props.caption: Caption text of the node. Default "node".
props.expanded: Whether the node is expanded. Default true; when collapsed the children move into _nodes_hidden and take no part in layout.
props.root: Whether this is the root node. Default false; a root node has no collapse button, does not draw itself and ignores expand/collapse.
props.nodes: List of child nodes stored as weak links; whether a child enters it is controlled by AddChild's isNode argument.
props.treeview: The owning TreeView (a weak link; New asserts that it is supplied).
props._nodes_hidden: Internal field: child controls moved out of children while collapsed, moved back on expand (internal).
props.OnSelectChange: Event table fired when the selection state changes; callback receives (selected) (triggered by TreeView:Select).
props.OnCollapse: Event table fired first thing when the node is collapsed.
props.OnExpand: Event table fired first thing when the node is expanded.
props.OnDraw: Custom drawing callback; when a listener returns true, the default DrawNode is skipped.

TreeViewNode:New.desc: For a root node padding is zeroed first; then it asserts that treeview is provided, converts it to a weak link and calls the parent constructor.

TreeViewNode:SetParent.desc: Clears treeview when the parent is not a table, then calls inherited.SetParent.

TreeViewNode:AddChild.desc: Unless isNode is false it records the child in nodes as a weak link, then asks the parent for RequestRealign and calls inherited.AddChild.

params.isNode: whether to record it as a tree node (false means a plain child control)

TreeViewNode:RemoveChild.desc: Calls inherited.RemoveChild and then removes the matching entry from nodes.

TreeViewNode:ClearChildren.desc: Clears the child controls but keeps the first caption child and the current expanded state (it calls Expand, clears, then Collapse again to restore); aliased as TreeViewNode.Clear.

TreeViewNode:Add.desc: A string creates a TextBox plus a matching child node, an Object is wrapped in a node with an empty caption; the new node is AddChild'ed and returned.

params.item: caption string or an existing control object

TreeViewNode:Select.desc: When the node is not root and not already selected, calls treeview:Select(self); the selection callbacks are fired by TreeView.

TreeViewNode:Toggle.desc: Flips the expand state: Collapse when expanded, Expand otherwise.

TreeViewNode:Expand.desc: Fires OnExpand, sets expanded=true, calls treeview:RequestRealign and moves the children in _nodes_hidden back into children.

TreeViewNode:Collapse.desc: Fires OnCollapse, sets expanded=false, calls treeview:RequestRealign and moves children[2..] into _nodes_hidden.

TreeViewNode:GetNodeByCaption.desc: Recursively (depth-first) searches nodes for a child node with a matching caption.

TreeViewNode:GetNodeByIndex.desc: Counting depth-first search that returns node number index; returning a number from the recursion signals the running count (propagated upward when not found).

params._i: running count, pass 0 at the root call

TreeViewNode:GetNodeByIndex.returns: the node object, or the running count number

TreeViewNode:UpdateLayout.desc: When collapsed (and not root) it applies a (0,0,clientWidth) constraint only to the first caption child and resizes to its height (height 10 when there is no child); when expanded it stacks children vertically and resizes to the total height.

TreeViewNode:_InNodeButton.desc: Tells whether the click point falls on the collapse triangle button on the left (x < padding[1] and vertically inside a centered band the height of the first child) (internal).

TreeViewNode:HitTest.desc: Forwards to the inherited HitTest to find a child; when nothing is hit it returns self so the whole node row is clickable.

TreeViewNode:MouseDown.desc: A root node simply forwards to the parent; hitting the collapse button returns self; in the text area within the first row it calls Select() before forwarding to the parent.

TreeViewNode:MouseClick.desc: Calls Toggle and returns self when the collapse button is hit, otherwise forwards to the parent MouseClick.

TreeViewNode:MouseDblClick.desc: Forwards to the parent first; when no child is hit it calls Toggle on itself and returns self.

TreeViewNode:DrawNode.desc: Calls treeview.DrawNode(self) to draw the node content when the node has an owning treeview.

TreeViewNode:DrawNodeTree.desc: Calls treeview.DrawNodeTree(self) so the treeview side can draw the tree decoration.

TreeViewNode:DrawControl.desc: A root node draws nothing; otherwise it fires the OnDraw listeners (returning true skips DrawNode) and then calls DrawNodeTree.

TreeViewNode:DrawChildren.desc: When collapsed and not root only the first (caption) child is drawn; otherwise all children are drawn in the clientArea through the 'Draw' channel.

TreeViewNode:DrawChildrenForList.desc: Same as DrawChildren, but children are drawn through the 'DrawForList' channel.

fileDesc: Defines TreeViewNode, covering child management, expand/collapse, recursive lookup, collapse-button interaction and drawing for tree nodes.
